The Infrastructure Cabling Services (ICS) Communications and Technical Analyst IV provides senior level operational and technical support for UC Davis Health’s telecommunications infrastructure and low voltage systems. Working within a multidisciplinary team that includes Registered Communications Distribution Designers (RCDDs), DAS engineers, and operational technicians, the incumbent collaborates closely with engineering, construction, and operational stakeholders to ensure telecommunications infrastructure supports reliability, redundancy, scalability, maintainability, and code compliance within mission-critical healthcare environments.
30% - Engineering and Operational Coordination
40% - Infrastructure Cabling Services Operations
15% - Low Voltage Cabling Construction Administration
10% - Communications Infrastructure Planning
5% - Creating and maintaining Division 27/28 specifications and Owner Project Requirements (OPR) documents.

Holding or willing to pursue an RCDD (Registered Communications Distribution Designer) or other BICSI credential such as DCDC, OSP, or Installer II (Copper/Fiber) demonstrating expertise in structured cabling and low-voltage infrastructure.
MS office, AutoCAD, Revit, Technical writing, Exclusive IT project management, Cable installation.
Maintain electronic equipment such as but not restricted to 800 MHZ & cellular DAS systems and/or Overhead paging systems.
Strong history of diplomatic collaboration with divisional leadership, facilities planning, and IT project management teams.
Advanced expertise in low-voltage design and construction management for healthcare or mission-critical environments.

Technical knowledge and demonstrated ability to engineer, design, and perform field work involving the electronic, optical, and physical characteristics of telecommunications systems, including Ethernet, DAS, 70V paging, analog telephony, and fiber-optic communications systems.

Ability to develop, articulate, document, and execute scopes of work related to information technology infrastructure, including, but not limited to, modifications and upgrades to new and existing Layer 1 physical telecommunications infrastructure.
Knowledge of overhead paging systems including 25 volt, 70 volt, and IP-based paging.
Working Knowledge of AutoCAD and Visio.
Effective verbal and written communication skills with the ability to work diplomatically across diverse stakeholders and cross-functional teams.
Working knowledge of IT Service Management (ITSM) practices and exposure to platforms such as ServiceNow.
Strong ability to interpret and apply relevant codes and standards, including BICSI TDMM, TIA/EIA, California Building Code, NFPA, California Fire Code, and HCAI regulations, UCDH IT Standards.
